ascensions.name: Walking Bomb
ascensions.desc: Its death-shrapnel hits for DOUBLE.

ascensions.name: Master of Puppets
ascensions.desc: Its skeletons RISE AGAIN when they fall.

ascensions.name: Winter of Souls
ascensions.desc: +70% spell power.

ascensions.name: Court of One
ascensions.desc: When it is the last of your units standing: a 120-point shield and +50% damage.

ascensions.name: Through the Veil
ascensions.desc: The first attack against it MISSES. FIRST STRIKE: +75% damage on the first landed basic attack against each enemy. Stacks additively with all other First Strike bonuses. A critting first hit takes the larger of the two.

ascensions.name: Soul Leech
ascensions.desc: Heals for 35% of the damage it deals.

ascensions.name: Grave Bloom
ascensions.desc: Its death raises TWO skeletons instead of one.

ascensions.name: Endless Hunger
ascensions.desc: Every kill feeds it: +20 max HP and +3 damage, for the rest of the fight.

ascensions.name: Deafening March
ascensions.desc: Your CASTERS' spells hit +20% harder while the drum beats. The gift leaves when it falls. Stacks with other horns.

ascensions.name: Drums of War
ascensions.desc: Your MELEE allies deal +15% damage while the drum beats. The gift leaves when it falls. Stacks with other horns.

ascensions.name: Pandemic
ascensions.desc: Its basic attacks lay 6 poison, and every infection SEEPS half the dose to foes within 1.8 cells.

ascensions.name: Rot Eternal
ascensions.desc: +60% spell power.

ascensions.name: Wail Unending
ascensions.desc: Her wail jumps to 2 MORE foes.

ascensions.name: Death's Chorus
ascensions.desc: Gains 8 mana when a unit from either starting army dies. Excludes summons and structures.

ascensions.name: Dread Sovereign
ascensions.desc: +60% drain power.

ascensions.name: Deathless
ascensions.desc: Revives once and gains +4 armor.

ascensions.name: Cataclysm
ascensions.desc: +50% breath power and it scorches 1 MORE target.

ascensions.name: Titanbone
ascensions.desc: +40% max HP.

ascensions.name: The Anvil
ascensions.desc: +4 armor, and reflects 12 + 12% of the blow onto every melee attacker.

ascensions.name: Grave-Rooted
ascensions.desc: +70% max HP.

ascensions.name: Master Tailor
ascensions.desc: +60% healing, and mending past full becomes a shield, up to the target's max HP per fight, until sudden death starts.

ascensions.name: Stitched Sinew
ascensions.desc: INSPIRES its nearest ally: +8 damage for the fight. Every INSPIRE source crowns its own nearest ally, and they add up on a shared one.

ascensions.name: Siegebreaker
ascensions.desc: FIRST STRIKE: +100% damage on the first landed basic attack against each enemy. Stacks additively with all other First Strike bonuses. A critting first hit takes the larger of the two. Its attacks ignore 12 armor.

ascensions.name: Scattershot
ascensions.desc: Each bolt also strikes 2 MORE foes, a third of the hit each and less per bolt.

ascensions.name: Big Knife
ascensions.desc: +50% damage and its cuts BLEED (3/s, stacks).

ascensions.name: Cutpurse
ascensions.desc: Every enemy it kills drops 1 gold for you after the fight, up to 3 gold per fight. Summons and raised bodies never count.

ascensions.name: Poison Tips
ascensions.desc: Its arrows lay 4 poison per hit.

ascensions.name: Spray An' Pray
ascensions.desc: Each arrow ALSO strikes the nearest other foe for a third of the hit, through its own armor.

ascensions.name: Death Mark
ascensions.desc: Its blink-strike deals +60% damage.

ascensions.name: Shadow Dance
ascensions.desc: Dives +1 MORE foe per blink, +10% dodge.

ascensions.name: Proper Angry
ascensions.desc: RAGES: up to +60% damage as its HP drops.

ascensions.name: Thick Skull
ascensions.desc: BLOCKS the first 2 hits it takes each battle. Does not stack with other blocks: the largest count applies.

ascensions.name: Headlong Charge
ascensions.desc: FIRST STRIKE: +100% damage on the first landed basic attack against each enemy. Stacks additively with all other First Strike bonuses. A critting first hit takes the larger of the two. Gains +0.6 move speed.

ascensions.name: Gore Horns
ascensions.desc: Its kills CRASH 40% of the blow onto the nearest foe.

ascensions.name: Loudest Roar
ascensions.desc: Its RALLY is 50% stronger.

ascensions.name: The Chosen
ascensions.desc: At the bell it names its CHOSEN: the nearest ally gains +12 damage, all fight.

ascensions.name: Strong Juju
ascensions.desc: Heals 60% stronger, and mending past full becomes a SHIELD, up to the target's max HP per fight, until sudden death starts.

ascensions.name: Two Doses
ascensions.desc: Each heal mends +1 MORE ally.

ascensions.name: Gorger
ascensions.desc: EATS its kills: +30 max HP (healed on the spot) per kill, all battle.

ascensions.name: Stone Hide
ascensions.desc: +5 armor and +8 thorns.

ascensions.name: Earthshaker
ascensions.desc: Its kills CRASH 50% of the blow onto the nearest foe.

ascensions.name: Too Angry to Die
ascensions.desc: REVIVES once at half HP, and comes back +40% angrier.

ascensions.name: Venom Fangs
ascensions.desc: Its bite lays 5 poison per hit.

ascensions.name: Sticky Silk
ascensions.desc: Its first landed bite on each foe CHILLS it: 30% slower attacks and movement. A foe already chilled by a first hit is not chilled again.

ascensions.name: Clamp
ascensions.desc: Its bites cannot be dodged.

ascensions.name: Ripping Jaws
ascensions.desc: Its bites OPEN WOUNDS: 8/s stacking bleed, and +25% damage.

ascensions.name: Bloodlust Banner
ascensions.desc: Your BLOODLUST allies deal +15% damage while it stands. The gift leaves when it falls. Stacks with other horns.

ascensions.name: Nailed Colours
ascensions.desc: Every ally WITHOUT bloodlust deals +10% damage while it stands. The gift leaves when it falls. Stacks with other horns.

ascensions.name: Rapid Growth
ascensions.desc: When it falls it GROWS UP: a Troll at half HP rises where it fell and fights on.

ascensions.name: Dig In
ascensions.desc: +2 armor for every second it stands still, all fight.

ascensions.name: Double Fuse
ascensions.desc: Every keg goes off TWICE: the second blast lands 0.3 s later at half power.

ascensions.name: Chain Fuses
ascensions.desc: The blast catches +2 MORE foes.

ascensions.name: Deep Vein
ascensions.desc: His blood rite deals +60% damage.

ascensions.name: Blood Tithe
ascensions.desc: Opens at 25% mana and gains +3 mana per attack. Starting mana does not stack with other starting-mana effects.

ascensions.name: Doublewide Barrel
ascensions.desc: Each slug ALSO strikes the nearest other foe for a third of the damage.

ascensions.name: Point Blank
ascensions.desc: FIRST STRIKE: +75% damage on the first landed basic attack against each enemy. Stacks additively with all other First Strike bonuses. A critting first hit takes the larger of the two. Its attacks ignore 8 armor.
